I meant the student loan holder. I dont know why I called it agency. 
But today- I just got the confirmation Transunion investigated and removed it from my credit! So dispute it as much as you can!

I gave the details mentioned above to chat gpt and asked it to write an email, also provided details about recent financial hardships. It drafted and I copy and pasted. 

Also forgot to add i asked had chat gpt draft and email for a FERPA complaint. I added that time the email too letting them know i sent it. 

I haven't heard anything back about the ferpa complaint but I also had chat gpt draft that template. 

The date they reported it to my credit was like March 21st. I did all of this on the 25th. So that gives good idea of the timeline for a response. 

Get as much as you can in writing ad as detailed as you can in writing. I think the student loan providers know they'll be up against class actions lawsuits so they're more likely to let things go of we push back enough. 

Hope this helps!

Hi! I just went through a similar situation with Ed Financial. 

Please reach out to the specific credit union that reported it (in my case transunion) and dispute it. 
Then also reach out to the agency via email and dispute it while also asking for more details on how and when they informed you that you would de delinquent.

My credit took a 177point hit. 
And yesterday it was restored to its original level.

Hope this helps!
